jobs.title: Product Manager - Storage
jobs.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The team Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking. European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it. The Role As a Storage Product Manager on the Cloud team, you will own the strategy and roadmap for Mistral's storage product portfolio. You have a deep understanding of the storage stack from block storage, distributed filesystems, object storage, and the evolving storage technology that accelerate AI/ML and HPC workloads. You understand what is slowing down the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud — translating those insights into products that are flexible, easy to build on, and performant at scale. You will work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to build new products and enhance existing offerings, ensuring alignment with technological advancements, customer expectations, and market trends. This is a highly critical role with significant influence over the future of AI compute and storage products. What You’ll Do Product strategy: Define and execute the product vision for Mistral's storage offerings — including distributed filesystem, block, and object storage to keep pace with the needs of AI training and inference at scale. Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Cloud Software Engineering, and SRE to define technical specifications, execution timelines, and the performance, reliability, scalability, and cost targets the different storage products must hit. Data strategy and architecture: Drive the data lifecycle, tiering, durability, and failure-domain strategy in close partnership with engineering. Roadmap ownership: Own and prioritize the storage product roadmap, balancing customer requests, technical feasibility, and business impact. Customer discovery: Build deep relationships with the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud, understand their storage needs and pain points, and act as their voice inside the company. Market Analysis: Research trends, opportunities, and challenges in the storage domain, and use these insights to guide product development and positioning. Technical translation: Distill complex technical tradeoffs into clear, compelling narratives and decision documents for company leadership. Performance monitoring: Track and analyze product performance metrics and use data-driven insights to guide product enhancements and future direction. What We’re Looking For 8+ years of experience in product management, with a strong focus on storage and cloud infrastructure, particularly in high-performance or AI-driven environments Strong understanding of storage technologies, including file system, block and object storage. Solid technical foundation and cloud-infrastructure knowledge. You’re comfortable reasoning about API semantics, control-plane vs data-plane behavior, system events and lifecycle, multi-tenant operational realities. You can engage with engineering teams as a peer, not as a translator. You can challenge an engineering tradeoff, not just relay one. Track record of shipping technically complex platform products with measurable impact. Strong analytical instincts with the ability to use data to inform and defend multi-year infrastructure decisions. Ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority, and to communicate credibly with executives, engineers, and customers. Low ego, high bias for action, and comfort in ambiguity — equally at home crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, a UX detail, or a customer escalation. Bonus You can reason about cloud storage economics, and how tiering across hot, warm, and cold tiers affects cost You've designed, or worked closely on, backup, replication, or disaster recovery products You're comfortable discussing storage performance characteristics: throughput, latency, IOPS, and how they map to real workloads What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page . Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy . Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Freelance Product Manager – AI for Quality & Regulatory
jobs.description: About Acodis Acodis is a Swiss software company based in Winterthur, providing AI-driven document processing for global Life Sciences companies. We help Quality and Regulatory teams move from document-centric to data-driven ways of working. The Mandate We are looking for an experienced freelance Product Manager to turn our AI platform into dedicated product solutions for two use cases. Working directly with management and our product engineering team, you will own both from discovery to market launch. Quality – Batch Record Review: AI-assisted review of executed batch records: checking completeness and correctness of entries, flagging deviations and GMP-relevant exceptions, and shortening review cycles ahead of batch disposition. Regulatory – CMC & Regulatory Submissions: Extraction and reuse of CMC data for submissions (CTD Module 3), consistency checks between source documents and submission content, and support for variations and post-approval changes. Mandate Deliverables Product definition & validation: Customer interviews, validated user workflows and value cases, and engineering-ready specifications and roadmap for both use cases. Pilot support: In our running pilots, including success criteria and a GxP-compliant validation approach. Go-to-market: Positioning, messaging, input and launch materials, together with the commercial team. Required Expertise 8+ years in product management or product consulting for digital, AI or enterprise software in Life Sciences. Hands-on expertise in batch record review and GMP manufacturing, or in CMC and regulatory submissions, with a solid understanding of GxP, data integrity and computerised system validation. Track record of taking products from concept to market, working independently on defined mandates. Nice to have: Experience with AI/LLM-based document processing, data pipelines, or platforms such as Veeva, MasterControl, Snowflake or Databricks. Mandate Details Duration & workload: 3–6 months from Jan/Feb 2027, 80–100%, extension possible. Location: Fully remote; no on-site presence in Winterthur required, but possible. Contract: Freelance (self-employed or via your own company) What We Offer A clearly scoped mandate with autonomy in how you deliver it. Direct access to management, engineering and customers, with short decision paths. The chance to shape two flagship products, with potential for a follow-on mandate. How to Apply Please upload your CV and relevant references, availability and daily rate to our recruiting platform. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
